key_insight: RLVR can adapt a model by keeping its weight spectrum fixed while changing only the input and output singular frames, enabling a new optimization paradigm called Isospectral Optimization (ISO).
engineering_relevance: ISO provides a practical post-training stack for reasoning and coding models that can merge specialists without data or rollouts and can accelerate online RLVR training with standard optimizers like AdamW and Muon.
method: ISO-Merger: combines multiple shared-base specialists by merging frame changes while preserving the base spectrum.
ISO-Optimizer: applies a chosen optimizer to frame variables only, keeping singular values fixed.
Works in both offline data-free merging and online training settings.
evidence_signal: Across 1.5B to 8B models, ISO-Optimizer improved reported accuracy and matched AdamW's 0.495 aggregate accuracy on Qwen3-8B-Base in 100 steps instead of 270, later reaching 0.509 by 210 steps.
watch_item: The approach depends on a stable spectral decomposition and may add implementation complexity when scaling to different model families or training pipelines.
